demos.title: japan(demo)
demos.desc: A demo that draws everything with one camera — from Japan's city data (PLATEAU) to the Solar System, from flat maps to 3D maps.

demos.title: Equal Earth
demos.desc: A scrolling Equal Earth world map with choropleths. Right-click any point to turn it into a 3D globe centered there.

demos.title: geoedit
demos.desc: A map editor. Draw and fix shapes on the 3D globe, and save them as GIS data.

demos.title: Nations of the World
demos.desc: Basic data for the countries and territories of the world, as cards — facts, flag and anthem, Wikipedia and map.

demos.title: World earthquakes
demos.desc: Reads USGS earthquake data directly and shows each quake in 3D by its energy and depth. It can also play year by year or month by month.

demos.title: Satellites
demos.desc: The current positions of satellites from CelesTrak data. Click a satellite to draw its orbit in 3D.

demos.title: ortho-solar
demos.desc: The current positions of the planets and their moons — and a replay of how they move over time.

demos.title: Make a video
demos.desc: Cut out scenes of the 3D map and save or play them as one continuous video.

demos.title: GeoPBF
demos.desc: Drop a GIS file, check it on the globe, write it in another format — 18 formats in, 14 out. The file never leaves your machine.

demos.title: Japan's open GIS data
demos.desc: View and convert the open GIS data published in Japan.

demos.title: census2020
demos.desc: Drill down into Japan's 2020 census — small-area statistics, disaster risk zones and land parcels.

demos.title: Satellite data (COG)
demos.desc: Satellite images (COG) on a server (Tellus), laid over the globe in 3D.

demos.title: ortho-japan
demos.desc: A map drawn only from Japan's public data. Try out the basic features.

demos.title: GLB models
demos.desc: Landmarks such as Tokyo Tower, placed on the globe as GLB models. Download them in a range of 3D formats.

demos.title: Aerial photo tiles
demos.desc: GSI aerial photo tiles. Any XYZ tiles or PMTiles can be shown in 3D.

demos.title: Statistics in 3D
demos.desc: A 3D graph from the 2020 census — every municipality raised by its population density.

demos.title: An old map of Edo
demos.desc: A woodblock map of Nihonbashi from 1850 (National Diet Library), laid on today's Tokyo.
